note: Example data: an invented online body-care shop with an invented Shopify store, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "repeat-purchase-planner" skill. Here is our Shopify orders export for the last 24 months and our products with unit costs. Most of our customers buy once. How do we increase our repeat purchase rate, and should we start a subscribe and save program?
source: orders export (Shopify, Orders, Export), reduced to one row per order: date | customer id | line items as SKUxquantity joined by + | subtotal after discounts, before shipping and tax | status (p paid, c cancelled, r refunded). No guest checkouts without an email in this export.

user_inputs.net_fulfilment_cost_note: carrier and packing per order, less the shipping fee customers pay on average
user_inputs.subscription_shipment_note: carrier and packing for a shipment that ships on its own; subscriptions would ship at no charge
user_inputs.sample_insert_note: one mini from the discovery kit, unit cost including the card
user_inputs.subscription_retention_note: no subscription program yet, so the skill's default assumptions apply

current_flows.name: Win-back
current_flows.offer: 15% off, sent to anyone with no order 45 days after their last one

products_export.name: Natural deodorant in a refillable case
